sentences.text: This small reptile measured less than two meters in length.
Chun Li named the type species Qianichthyosaurus zhoui in 1999.
A second variety, Qianichthyosaurus xingyiensis, was described in 2013 by Pengfei Yang and colleagues from Ladinian layers.
The later species possessed a snout that extended further than that of the original type.
Complete skeletons are frequently found in the Xiaowa Formation, including young individuals and pregnant adults.
Together with its relative Toretocnemus, this genus forms the family Toretocnemidae.
Qianichthyosaurus inhabited the Late Triassic epoch between 239.48 and 227.3 million years ago.
Remains were discovered in the Falang Formation near Huangtutang in Guizhou, southeastern China.
